description: This source file defines a React component for a Next.js frontend app that allows users to upload documents, generate a persona draft via backend API orchestration, view and edit the generated persona, and manage version histories. It includes user interface elements such as headers, upload zones, persona display areas, and progress indicators, with logic for handling file uploads, polling backend status, and state management.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a user's experience with fields like id, role, company, date, description.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Represents the persona information including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Represents uploaded files with id and File object.

methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON string safely, fallback to string if serialization fails.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-friendly message from an error object or string.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value in an object by path array and returns the value with its found path.

methods.description: Logs available keys within an object to aid debugging shape mismatches.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record by checking multiple candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData shape, handling different possible schemas.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the UI for uploading documents, generating, and editing a persona draft, including polling, state management, and layout.
